The '''Bright Coast''' is a stretch of coastline to the west of [[Lapidis Isle]]. The Bright Coast is occupied by pirates of the [[Southsea Freebooters]], who under the leadership of [['Water Rat' Jorgy]] have established camps along the shore after being stranded on the island along with the [[Kul Tiran Exploratory Fleet]].
